SERIES of 2016
ORDINANCE NO. 0118-16
AN ORDINANCE AMENDING ORDINANCE NO. 0234-15, SERIES OF 2015, OTHERWISE
KNOWN AS THE DAVAO CITY TRAFFIC CODE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.
